# dsh-smoothness
Three small, focused plugins for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) that make long agent sessions easier to fo
small, focused plugins for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) that make long agent sessions easier to follow:
| Plugin | What it does |
| **dsh-btw** (旁聊 / Side Chat) | A side conversation about the current Session. Ask about progress,

errors, or next steps — or just chat — without writing anything into the main conversation. |
| **ds
h-assets** (资产 / Assets) | A session-scoped browser for installed skills and rules. Every asset gets

a one-line summary and a switch; user projects and DSH presets are separate skill packs. |
| **dsh-
save-load** (存档 / 读档) | A `/` command that archives a long Session as a handoff manual, then loads a
saved manual into a fresh Session. |
All three plugins are plain JavaScript, install from GitHub with no build step, and only add UI/cont
ext to the **Web** profile. Their UI ships in native English and Chinese.

## dsh-btw — Side Chat

- A floating side-chat panel, opened from the composer dock.
- The Host snapshots the current live S
ession (recent messages, tool calls/results, todo list, turn state) and answers with the Session's c

urrent model.
- Answers stream; side threads are kept per Session in Host memory.
- Nothing is appen

ded to the Session log: the main conversation and its next request are untouched.
- The model is rea
d-only: no tools, no file edits, no Session writes.
See dsh-btw/README.md for details and limits.
## dsh-assets — Assets
- Two tabs: **Skills** and **Rules**. DSH already has its own plugin inventory, so Assets does not d

uplicate plugin rows.
- **Skills** has two sections: **用户技能包** (user-installed projects such as Agen
t Reach, Moli, HyperFrames, IndexTTS, and wallstreet-explainer) and **DSH预设** (every other skill). A
skill counts as user-installed when Codex's registry (`~/.cursor/skills`) symlinks it or when its o
wn provenance (metadata, repository URL, shared prefix, cross-references) identifies it, so plain lo
cal skills like wallstreet-explainer appear without any metadata. Skill packs start collapsed; click
a pack to reveal its child skills. Both sections list skills whether or not this Session has them e

nabled, and each skill shows its current state.
- The **用户技能包** header carries **Update** and **Upda
te log** buttons. Update pulls the latest commit from each skill's official GitHub repository; when
a local skill has local modifications (or diverged history) the panel opens a conflict dialog offeri
ng **keep local**, **take the official remote**, or **stash then update**. Skills with no declared o
rigin are matched through the bundled `find-skills` skill (GitHub repository search by name), and th

e update history is recorded under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-assets/update-log.json`.
- Your own proje
cts are discovered dynamically from the installed skills: explicit `metadata.homepage` / `repository
` / `project` / `version` frontmatter, a repository URL matching a skill's prefix, a non-generic pre
fix shared by at least two skills, or cross-skill `../<skill>` references. No project list is compil
ed into the plugin, so a new project install appears after the catalog refreshes; versions and types

appear only when the project declares them in metadata.
- Every skill row has a session-scoped swit
ch. Disabled skills disappear from that Session's model catalog; disabled rule files stop being inje

cted into its system-prompt context.
- `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` are shown as DSH-managed and read-o

nly, so they are never double-injected.
- Per-Session state lives under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-asse
ts/state.json`; it is policy, not profile configuration.
See dsh-assets/README.md for details and limits.
## dsh-save-load — Save / Load

- Adds **Archive / Load** (`存档 / 读档`) to the `/` command menu.
- **Archive** summarizes the live Ses
sion into a handoff manual: completed work, unfinished work and next steps, pitfalls, cautions, user
preferences, key files, and current state. A floating status window reports progress. Repeated clic
ks share one in-flight archive; one unchanged Session reuses its existing archive, and a later save

with new events updates that same archive instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Load** opens a new Se

ssion with the selected handoff already in the composer; press Enter to start the relay.
- Archives
are local JSON files under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-save-load/archives/`. The source Session log is n
files under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-save-load/archives/`. The source Session log is never modified.
See dsh-save-load/README.md for details and limits.
## Repository layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Each directory is a complete `dsh.bundle` package with its own `cordis.patch.yml`, locale files, and
icon. There is no root runtime package.
## Discovery
Use the `dsh-plugin` topic for discovery — the convention recommended by the DeepSeek Harness README
and CONTRIBUTING guide. Add it under **About → Topics** on this repository.
